video.title: AI欧腐《什么！？我和死对头有了孩子/ What!? I Have A Child With My Rival》
video.desc:
18-year-old Alpha boxing champ Ryan wakes up eight years in the future as a disgraced Omega, permanently marked by his billionaire rival, Justin! Burdened with bankrupt parents and a scheming ex, Ryan wreck the scum, reclaim his everything, and conquer the ring alongside Justin!
18岁的 Alpha 拳击冠军Ryan一觉醒来，竟来到了八年后的未来，变成了声名狼藉的 Omega，还被他的亿万富豪死对头Justin永久标记！
面对濒临破产的父母和心机前任的重重算计，Ryan决定手撕渣滓，夺回属于自己的一切，并与Justin并肩重返拳台，征服赛场！
